entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so confused by the website and the policies. I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear the site was confusing. To start, can I get your name and order number?
It's Sarah Miller, order number 772-B-901. It's just... I'm not sure what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Sarah. That's what I'm here for. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see it here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, so about 39 days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh no, it works fine. I think. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My father was rushed to the hospital and needed an unexpected surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

Thank you. Between his recovery and my brother getting a sudden military deployment, this just got put in a drawer and forgotten. By the time I remembered, I just assumed I was too late. I feel helpless.
I completely understand why that would slip your mind. It sounds like you've had a lot to deal with. Let me just take a quick look at the official return policy for your item. One moment.

Okay, Sarah, I have good news. I've just checked our system, and your VeloBand is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. Since you're only on day 39, we can absolutely process that return for a full refund. No exception needed.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you. I was so worried it would be a problem.

Not a problem at all. I'm glad I could make things a little easier for you. I'm sending the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. You should see it pop up in the next few minutes.
Thank you so much, David. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do hope things get easier for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
